test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 01 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A cage made for birds.

OR

A place for keeping the birds in a confined space.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Aviary**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Aviary"** is a large cage, building, or enclosure for keeping birds in. (पक्षीशाला)

 
 
• **Example: **The zoo's aviary houses birds from all over the world, providing visitors a glimpse into their diverse habitats.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct one-word substitute for a place for keeping birds in a confined space is **'Aviary'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Aquarium **(एक्वेरियम): A place for the exhibition and study of fish and other aquatic animals.

 
 
• **Example:** The children were fascinated by the colorful fish swimming in the aquarium.
 
 
 
• **Apiary **(मधुमक्खी पालन केंद्र ): A place where bees are bred, typically for their honey.
 
 
• **Example: **Visiting the apiary, we learned how bees produce honey and their importance in pollination.
 
 
 
• **Arena** (अखाड़ा): A place with a flat open area in the middle and seats around it where people can watch sports and entertainment.
 
 
• **Example:** The national championship will be held in the newly built sports arena.
